title: Smooth even normalized kernel on the unit ball with a radial potential Psi satisfying DPsi(z)[v] = rho(z)<z,v>
statement: For every n in N there exist functions rho, Psi : R^n -> R (R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n)) such that: rho and Psi are C^infinity; rho(z) = 0 and Psi(z) = 0 whenever |z| >= 1; rho(-z) = rho(z) for all z; int_{R^n} rho(z) dz = 1 (Lebesgue measure); and DPsi(z)[v] = rho(z) <z, v> for all z, v in R^n, where DPsi(z)[v] = fderiv R Psi z v.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ρ Ψ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → Ψ z = 0) ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, ρ (-z) = ρ z) ∧ ∫ z, ρ z = 1 ∧ ∀ z v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ Ψ z v = ρ z * inner ℝ z v
